description:
Returns one watchlist: its companies, when each was last scanned and how that went,
and the progress of any scan in progress.

A scan's `status` moves through running and settling to completed. Settling means
the companies are done and the last signals are still being written, so read results
once it reports completed.

Cost: free — call it as often as you need.

watchlist.description: The list, by its id (wl_...) or its exact name.

name: get_watchlist
title: Get Watchlist
